title: How to set up the FireClient HUD in Minecraft 1.21.1
excerpt: Open the FireClient menu with Right Shift, switch on the HUD elements you want and drag them into place with the HUD editor.

title: Install FireClient on Windows in five steps
excerpt: Download the installer, check its SHA-256, run it, sign in and launch Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric to get the in-game menu.

title: FireClient 1.0 is available as a free Windows beta
excerpt: The launcher and the Fabric in-game client for Minecraft 1.21.1 are free to download for Windows 10 and 11.
